token.description:
Token is the plaintext credential. Returned exactly once — it is never
retrievable again, and it is never logged (see the handler below).

override_id.description: OverrideID is set only on override segments; lets clients delete the override.

key_rule.description: per-key silence rule covers this incident

scheduled.description: rule exists, window not yet open

trigger_rule.description: trigger-wide silence rule covers this incident

duration.description: Duration is a Go-style duration string, e.g. "1h30m". Min 1 minute, max 30 days.

starts_at.description:
StartsAt optionally schedules the silence to begin in the future (RFC3339).
Omitted or in the past => begins immediately (current behavior).
RFC3339; blank or unparsable falls back to the sample time

is_regex.description: IsRegex opts into safe full-key regex matching. It defaults to false.

starts_at.description:
StartsAt optionally schedules the silence to begin in the future (RFC3339).
Omitted or in the past => begins immediately (current behavior).

token.description: one-time bearer token; empty for auth_method=none

is_regex.description:
IsRegex is false for exact-key and trigger-wide rules. When true,
DedupKey is a validated full-key RE2 expression.

scheduled.description:
Scheduled is true when silenced_from is still in the future (status='pending') —
the rule exists but has not started enforcing yet.

silenced_until.description:
SilencedUntil is the new absolute end time (RFC3339). Setting (not
extending) the window lets a caller shorten as well as lengthen it.

message.description: Message is spoken to the callee via inline <Say> TwiML. Ignored when TwimlURL is set.

status_callback.description: StatusCallback, when non-empty, is the URL Twilio POSTs call status updates to.

status_callback_event.description:
StatusCallbackEvent filters which call events trigger the callback (e.g. "completed", "no-answer").
Twilio defaults to all events when omitted.

twiml_url.description: TwimlURL, when non-empty, points Twilio at hosted TwiML instead of the inline Message.

status_callback.description: StatusCallback, when non-empty, is the URL Twilio POSTs message status updates to.

post.description: Silences incidents for the specified duration. With a dedup_key, only incidents matching that exact key are silenced by default. Optionally schedule a future start with `starts_at` (RFC3339); omitted starts immediately. Re-silencing the same scope extends the window (set-from-now).

Returns the Oncall person per tier at a given instant. Defaults to now. Response is an object keyed by tier number (integer), each value being an Oncall segment.
Resolves the Oncall schedule into per-layer segments for a time window. Defaults to the current week (Mon–Sun UTC). Window is capped at 180 days.

Downloads a one-time RFC 5545 iCalendar snapshot for the explicit half-open [from,to) window. Scope may be team (the default) or personal (only the authenticated caller's shifts); callers cannot select another user. Both timestamps must be whole-second RFC3339 instants and the window may not exceed 180 days. Authenticated callers may export visible_to_all_teams schedules; other schedules require schedules:view (or admin/global viewer access). Exports are limited to 100,000 resolution steps and 10,000 events and contain no subscription, refresh, or feed URL properties.

Fast-forwards the next pending outbox message that does not belong to the
acting responder's own contact-method chain. No-op when nothing else is pending.

get.description: Returns the notification outbox messages for an incident, oldest first, paginated.

post.description: Transitions incident to 'resolved', cancels pending notifications, fires state_change targets.

delete.description: Immediately restores a silenced incident to its pre-silence status. The optional scope parameter controls which silence rule(s) are removed: "key" removes all exact or regex rules covering the incident's dedup key, "trigger" removes only the trigger-wide rule, "both" removes both. Omit scope for default key behavior (keyless incidents default to trigger-wide). The optional phase parameter controls which time-slot is removed: "active" removes only currently-enforcing rules, "pending" removes only scheduled (not-yet-started) rules, "both" (default) removes both.

parameters.description: Which rule(s) to cancel: key | trigger | both (default: all rules covering the incident key)
parameters.name: scope

parameters.description: Which time-slot to cancel: active | pending | both (default: both)
parameters.name: phase

get.description: Returns which silence rule(s) cover the incident: a per-key rule, a trigger-wide rule, or both — including rules scheduled for a future start.
get.summary: Get silence coverage for an incident

post.description: Silences an incident for the specified duration. Optionally schedule a future start with `starts_at` (RFC3339); omitted starts immediately. On expiry the incident returns to its pre-silence status. Re-silencing an already-silenced incident extends the window (set-from-now).

oneOf.description: Silence duration and optional future start

requestBody.description: Silence duration and optional future start

post.description: Transitions an acknowledged incident back to 'open' (firing). No-op for any other status.

post.description: Receives an integration payload and dispatches an Oncall SMS notification via Twilio. All payload fields are required.

Places a Twilio voice call to the number in the body. When the callee
answers, Twilio fetches TwiML from /twilio/voice/{incidentID}/{contactMethodID}.

Receives the keypad digit the callee pressed, validates the
X-Twilio-Signature, and routes it to the incident pipeline.

Receives Twilio's form-encoded inbound-SMS webhook, validates the
X-Twilio-Signature, looks up the most recent SMS action session for
the sender's number, and routes the reply digit to the incident pipeline.

Receives Twilio's voice call status-callback POST, validates the
X-Twilio-Signature, records the delivery outcome on the incident
notification log, and (when ONCALL_TWILIO_AUTOADVANCE_ON_FAILURE=true)
auto-advances escalation on terminal non-delivery statuses.

Receives Twilio's SMS message status-callback POST, validates the
X-Twilio-Signature, records the delivery outcome on the incident
notification log, and (when ONCALL_TWILIO_AUTOADVANCE_ON_FAILURE=true)
auto-advances escalation on terminal non-delivery statuses.

Fetched by Twilio when an outbound call is answered. Returns TwiML
that prompts the callee and gathers a single keypad (DTMF) digit.
